svg.title: Lead pipeline: vision versus code
svg.desc: Seven pipeline steps with their state: 1 Hiring signals partial; 2 The person missing; 3 Contact route partial; 4 Opportunity partial; 5 Resume built, not wired; 6 E-mail partial; 7 Approval, tracking partial. Funnel from the 2026-11-07 run: LinkedIn posts exported 2000, with an e-mail in the text 1224, new after repost folding 785, opportunities (785 LinkedIn + 119 feed jobs) 904, kept by lead-filter 8, ready drafts after manual review 2.
